name: Mendeley DDH hip sets (jf3pv98m9g and 4gvcb6gmh2)
what: infant and child AP pelvis radiographs with developmental dysplasia labels: jf3pv98m9g (Jordan, 354 subjects) and 4gvcb6gmh2 (AV-DDH, 2,417 infant hip films, updated 2026-03); the lumbosacral junction in field at low exposure
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the only sizeable pediatric pelvic film source found
licence: CC BY 4.0 (to confirm on the page)
how_to_get: Open https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/jf3pv98m9g and https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/4gvcb6gmh2 and read each licence line, version and file list.
Fetch each as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the public-files address the page gives.
